name: Ultimate Lifeform Scaled
description: Everything in the Shadow build, plus the static enemy difficulty curve, retuned once POW and GRT were confirmed. HP carries the weight (8%/level, so Lord Ix at level 10 gains 80%) because a longer fight still shows the damage numbers you earned. Damage is a moderate 3.5%/level. Grit and defense are left at zero on purpose: grit shrinks your damage numbers and defense most likely makes you miss, and both read as the game cheating rather than as difficulty.
